Container.Name: android-backup
Container.Overview: Backs up Android phones and tablets to your array over ADB, with no root and no app on the device. Plug a device in, or give it a Wi-Fi address, and it gets one backup per day: shared storage (photos, downloads, documents), every user-installed APK, contacts as vCard, SMS and call log in SMS Backup & Restore format, the calendar, and settings. The previous copy of a changed file is kept for 30 days. Files deleted on the phone are kept in the backup. Private app data (logins, app databases) can't be backed up without root. Status page + Prometheus /metrics on port 9872, a Home Assistant sensor endpoint, and Apprise alerts (ntfy, Home Assistant, Discord and more). The status page has no login: keep it on your LAN.
Container.Requires: USB debugging turned on on each device, and "Allow" tapped once when it's first connected.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Status page, /metrics and /api/ha. There is no login, so do not publish this port outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Each device gets a <model>-<serial> folder. It holds messages and contacts in plain text, so use a private share.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: State, logs and the adb key devices trust; keep this folder private

Config.Name: USB devices
Config.Description: For devices plugged into the server

Config.Name: Backup interval (hours)
Config.Description: Minimum time between good backups of a device

Config.Name: Wi-Fi devices
Config.Description: Optional comma list of host:port, e.g. 192.168.1.50:5555. See the README for setup.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and snapshot dates

Config.Name: Apprise URLs
Config.Description: Where alerts go: Apprise URLs separated by spaces, e.g. ntfys://TOKEN@ntfy.example.com/backups hassio://HA_HOST/LONG_LIVED_TOKEN. A URL gets every event; put event names in front (stale,failed=URL) to limit it. These hold tokens, so the field is masked. See the README.

Config.Name: Notify on success
Config.Description: true = also send an alert for each successful backup

Config.Name: Apprise config file
Config.Description: Optional: an Apprise config file to use as well as, or in place of, the URLs above, e.g. /config/apprise.yml

Config.Name: Events to send
Config.Description: Comma list from: started, success, failed, needs_unlock, unauthorized, wifi_lost, stale. Blank = all but started and success (only failed when just the legacy Discord webhook is set). A choice saved under Alert settings on the status page wins over this.

Config.Name: Stale after (hours)
Config.Description: Alert once when a device has had no good backup for this long. 0 = off

Config.Name: Wi-Fi lost after (hours)
Config.Description: Alert once when a Wi-Fi device address has been unreachable for this long (a phone forgets adb tcpip 5555 when it reboots). 0 = off

Config.Name: Discord webhook (legacy)
Config.Description: Legacy, prefer Apprise URLs. An existing webhook keeps working: failed backups are posted to it.

Config.Name: Retry minutes
Config.Description: Wait after a failed attempt

Config.Name: Mobile data limit (MB)
Config.Description: On mobile data (e.g. Tailscale over LTE) a backup copies new files up to this much, plus contacts/SMS; app updates and the rest wait for Wi-Fi

Config.Name: Snapshots to keep
Config.Description: Dated contacts/SMS/settings snapshots per device

Config.Name: Only while charging
Config.Description: true = a scheduled backup waits until the device is on a charger. Back up now always runs.

Config.Name: Backup window
Config.Description: Optional: scheduled backups only start between these times, e.g. 01:00-06:00. Blank = any time. Back up now always runs.

Config.Name: Keep old versions (days)
Config.Description: When a file changes on the device, its previous copy is kept in versions/ for this many days. 0 = overwrite, keep nothing

Config.Name: Largest file to version (MB)
Config.Description: A changed file bigger than this is overwritten without keeping its previous copy

Config.Name: Only these serials
Config.Description: Optional comma list; default = every authorised device
